protocol.name: wlr_data_control_unstable_v1
protocol.description:
This protocol allows a privileged client to control data devices. In particular, the client will be able to manage the current selection and take the role of a clipboard manager.
Warning! The protocol described in this file is experimental and backward incompatible changes may be made. Backward compatible changes may be added together with the corresponding interface version bump. Backward incompatible changes are done by bumping the version number in the protocol and interface names and resetting the interface version. Once the protocol is to be declared stable, the 'z' prefix and the version number in the protocol and interface names are removed and the interface version number is reset.

interface.name: zwlr_data_control_manager_v1
interface.description: This interface is a manager that allows creating per-seat data device controls.

request.name: get_data_device

description.summary: get a data device for a seat

request.description: Creates a data device that can be used to manage a seat's selection.

request.name: destroy
request.description: All objects created by the manager will still remain valid, until their appropriate destroy request has been called.

interface.name: zwlr_data_control_device_v1
interface.description:
This interface allows a client to manage a seat's selection.
When the seat is destroyed, this object becomes inert.

request.name: set_selection
request.description:
This request asks the compositor to set the selection to the data from the source on behalf of the client.
The given source may not be used in any further set_selection or set_primary_selection requests. Attempting to use a previously used source is a protocol error.
To unset the selection, set the source to NULL.

event.name: data_offer
event.description: The data_offer event introduces a new wlr_data_control_offer object, which will subsequently be used in either the wlr_data_control_device.selection event (for the regular clipboard selections) or the wlr_data_control_device.primary_selection event (for the primary clipboard selections). Immediately following the wlr_data_control_device.data_offer event, the new data_offer object will send out wlr_data_control_offer.offer events to describe the MIME types it offers.

event.name: selection
event.description: The selection event is sent out to notify the client of a new wlr_data_control_offer for the selection of this device. The wlr_data_control_device.data_offer and the wlr_data_control_offer.offer events are sent out immediately before this event to introduce the data offer object. The selection may be unavailable if no application has set it, if it is empty or if the client is not yet ready to receive it and a compositor performs timing optimizations. The offer argument may therefore be NULL.

event.name: finished

description.summary: this data control is no longer valid

event.description: This data control object is no longer valid and should be destroyed. This happens for example if the client used a data source that was already used.

event.name: primary_selection
event.description: The primary_selection event is sent out to notify the client of a new wlr_data_control_offer for the primary selection of this device. The wlr_data_control_device.data_offer and the wlr_data_control_offer.offer events are sent out immediately before this event to introduce the data offer object. The primary selection may be unavailable if no application has set it, if it is empty or if the client is not yet ready to receive it and a compositor performs timing optimizations. The offer argument may therefore be NULL.

request.name: set_primary_selection

description.summary: copy data to the primary selection

request.description:
This request asks the compositor to set the primary selection to the data from the source on behalf of the client.
The given source may not be used in any further set_selection or set_primary_selection requests. Attempting to use a previously used source is a protocol error.
To unset the primary selection, set the source to NULL.
The source argument must be NULL if and only if the compositor does not support primary selection. Compositors that do not support this feature will delete any previous primary selection.

interface.name: zwlr_data_control_source_v1
interface.description: The wlr_data_control_source object is the source side of a wlr_data_control_offer. It is created by the source client using the wlr_data_control_device.create_data_source request and is owned by the source client. The target client will use the wlr_data_control_offer interface to accept and perform the transfer.

request.name: offer
request.description: This request adds a MIME type to the set of MIME types advertised to targets. Can be called several times to offer multiple types.

arg.name: mime_type
arg.summary: MIME type offered by the data source

event.name: send
event.description: Request for data from the client. Send the data as the specified MIME type over the passed file descriptor, then close it.

event.name: cancelled
event.description:
This data source is no longer valid. The data source has been replaced by another data source.
The client should clean up and destroy this data source.

interface.name: zwlr_data_control_offer_v1
interface.description: A wlr_data_control_offer represents a piece of data offered for transfer by another client (the source client). It is used by the copy-and-paste mechanism. The offer describes the different MIME types that the source client has available for transfer.

request.name: receive

description.summary: request that the data is transferred

request.description:
To transfer the offered data, the client issues this request and indicates the MIME type it wants to receive. The transfer happens through the passed file descriptor (typically created with the pipe system call). The source client writes the data in the MIME type representation requested and then closes the file descriptor.
The receiving client reads from the read end of the pipe until EOF and then closes its end, at which point the transfer is complete.
This request may happen multiple times for different MIME types.

event.name: offer
event.description: Sent immediately after creating the wlr_data_control_offer object. One event per offered MIME type.
